basis: Loaded DOUBLE ZEROFILL value is exactly zero; a negative string-result constant cannot equal zero. Numeric comparison of formatted zerofill output, not raw display width.
allowed_warning_note: DELAYED ignored and ZEROFILL deprecation warnings are not bug evidence.
phase_rule: Execute original SQL unchanged and in order, then separately captured read-only validation SQL; validation is required before classification.
on_sql_error: These selected reports target wrong results, not SQL errors; unexpected SQL errors mean execution_failed, never automatically reproduced.
on_other_pattern: other_anomaly; do not attribute an unexpected pattern to the report
